quests.title: A trail of one gem
quests.ask: The trail is a single gem under the robot. Pick it up and stop on the empty cell just after it.
quests.nudge: What tells the robot the trail is over: the wall, or something else?

quests.title: A longer trail
quests.ask: A longer trail with room after it. Pick up every gem and stop on the first empty cell, well before the wall.
quests.nudge: Which steps happen once for every gem on the trail?

quests.title: No trail at all
quests.ask: Sometimes the robot starts on an empty cell. There's nothing to pick up, so it should stay where it is.
quests.nudge: Does your program pick or move before it has looked?
